次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This flower has thin stems and very fine leaves. Pink, white, or red flowers move easily in the wind. In Japan, fields of it are a familiar sight in autumn.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This flower has many petals with uneven edges. It lasts well after being cut. In Japan, red or pink ones are often given to mothers on their special day.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This plant grows from a bulb and often has large flowers. Long parts carrying pollen stand inside the flower. Its strong smell and trumpet-like shape make many kinds easy to notice.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Small white flowers hang in a row from this plant. Each looks like a tiny bell pointing down. Its leaves are broad, but all parts of the plant are poisonous.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This flower is important in Japanese tradition and often blooms in autumn. Some kinds have many long, thin petals. A special sixteen-petal design is connected with the Japanese emperor.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tree often flowers before spring feels warm. Its small fruit is very sour and is usually not eaten raw. Japanese people pickle it to put inside rice balls.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sweet fruit has soft skin covered with very fine hairs. A large hard stone sits in the middle. In a Japanese story, a boy comes out of one.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This round fruit grows on trees. Its skin can be red, green, or yellow, and its inside is firm. In a famous story, a poisoned one makes a princess fall asleep.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This long fruit often grows in a group. You remove its thick yellow skin before eating the soft inside. Its curved shape makes it easy to recognize in shops.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Many small round fruits grow together in a bunch. Their skin can be green, purple, or dark red. People eat them fresh or use their juice to make wine.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small red fruit has a green top. Tiny seed-like dots cover its outside rather than hiding in the middle. It is often placed on a white cream cake.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large summer fruit has thick green skin. Its inside is often red and full of water. Dark seeds sit in the sweet flesh, which people cut into big slices.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This round fruit has sweet, juicy flesh. Some kinds have a net-like pattern on the skin. Many soft seeds sit together in the center, and people remove them before eating.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tropical fruit has a hard, rough outside. Long pointed green leaves grow from its top. The yellow flesh tastes sweet and sour, and the middle can be rather hard.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This yellow fruit has a very sour juice. People squeeze it onto food or put a slice in tea. Its oval shape often has a small point at each end.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small orange fruit is easy to peel by hand. The inside separates into several soft pieces. In Japan, people often eat it while sitting at a warm table in winter.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This autumn fruit is usually orange when ripe. Four firm leaf-like parts remain at its top. Some kinds taste sweet immediately, while others need treatment or drying before eating.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This round fruit has white, crisp, juicy flesh. Common Japanese kinds have brownish or greenish skin with tiny dots. It has a core with seeds, much like an apple.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small red fruit has a long thin stem. A hard stone is hidden inside its shiny skin. People sometimes find two fruits joined together at the ends of their stems.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This fruit has brown skin covered in short hairs. When cut, it often shows green flesh and a pale center. Many tiny black seeds form a ring around the middle.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tropical fruit has smooth skin and a large flat stone. Its orange flesh is soft and very sweet when ripe. Cooks may cut a grid into it and turn it outward.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This fruit has a large round stone in its center. The flesh is greenish, soft, and rich rather than sweet. People often add it to salads or spread it on toast.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This brown nut has a hard, shiny shell. Before it is gathered, a very spiky green case surrounds it. People roast it or cook it with rice in autumn.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tall plant grows in straight sections with clear joints. Its stems are often hollow inside. Young shoots can be eaten, and pandas spend much of their time eating this plant.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tree keeps its narrow needle-like leaves through winter. It produces woody cones instead of colorful fruit. In Japan, its branches are often used in decorations placed at entrances for the New Year.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tree has leaves shaped like small fans. In autumn, they turn bright yellow. Some trees drop fruits with a strong smell, and the seeds inside can be eaten after cooking.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tall Japanese tree often grows in forests planted for wood. Its trunk can be very straight. In spring, pollen from it causes sneezing and itchy eyes for many people.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tree is often planted beside water. Its long, thin branches hang downward like curtains. Small narrow leaves move gently in the wind, giving the tree a soft appearance.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Many kinds of this plant live in dry places. Thick green stems store water, and sharp spines cover the outside. Some kinds look like tall columns, while others are round.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This plant has thick, pointed leaves with small sharp edges. A clear wet gel is found inside the leaves. Some kinds are used in skin products or prepared as food.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This low plant usually has three leaflets on each leaf. It often grows in grass and has small round flower heads. Finding a leaf with four parts is considered lucky.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small plant reacts when touched. Its many little leaflets fold together, and the leaf may droop. After some time, it opens again if nothing keeps disturbing it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This unusual plant gets extra food from insects. Its leaves have two sides with tooth-like edges. When an insect touches the right hairs inside, the two sides can close around it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This plant often grows in shallow water in fields. Its heads become heavy with grains and bend downward. After removing the outer layers, people cook those grains as Japan's main food.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This field crop has heads full of grains. The grains are ground into flour after harvesting. That flour is used for bread, cakes, and many kinds of noodles around the world.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tall plant produces rows of yellow grains on a thick center. Green leaves wrap around them before harvest. People can eat the grains or heat special kinds until they pop.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These beans are an important food ingredient in Japan. They can become white blocks, sticky breakfast food, or dark salty sauce. The young green beans are also eaten after boiling.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This plant has an unusual way of growing its food. After flowering above ground, the seed cases develop under the soil. Each dry rough shell often holds two edible seeds.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
The part of this plant that people eat grows underground. It has pale flesh and small spots called eyes. People boil it, mash it, or cut it into sticks and fry it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This root vegetable often has reddish purple skin. Its yellow or pale inside becomes sweet when cooked. In Japan, people slowly roast it and sell it hot in cold weather.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This vegetable grows a long root under the soil. The root is usually orange and becomes narrower at the end. Green leaves grow above it, and rabbits are often shown eating it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese vegetable has a long, thick white root. It can be cooked until soft or grated into tiny wet pieces. Its green leaves can also be used as food.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This round vegetable has many layers inside a dry outer skin. Cutting it can make your eyes fill with tears. Cooking it slowly often changes its sharp taste into sweetness.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small white bulb is divided into several pieces under thin skin. It has a strong smell when cut or crushed. Cooks add it to meat, sauces, and many other dishes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This cooking ingredient has a pale brown outside and a yellowish inside. Its shape is uneven, with several branching parts. A small amount gives food a warm, sharp taste and smell.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This vegetable grows in mud beneath a water plant. When you cut it across, a pattern of round holes appears. The crisp slices are often used in Japanese cooking.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This vegetable looks like a long, thin brown stick. The part people eat is a root with a firm texture. Japanese cooks often cut it into strips and cook it with carrots.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Many broad leaves wrap tightly together to form this round vegetable. The outside is usually green, and the inside is paler. Thin strips are often served beside fried pork in Japan.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This leafy vegetable has a long, oval head. Its thick white lower parts lead to wrinkled pale green leaves. In Japan, people often put it into shared winter hot pots.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This leafy vegetable has dark green leaves and thin stems. People often boil it briefly before eating. A famous cartoon sailor gains great strength after eating a can of it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This green vegetable looks like a tiny tree. Many small unopened flowers form its top. People cut it into smaller pieces and usually cook it before adding it to meals.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This vegetable has thick skin and firm orange or yellow flesh. Many flat seeds fill its hollow center. Large orange kinds are carved into faces for a festival in October.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This vegetable often has smooth, shiny purple skin. A green cap sits at one end of its long or round body. Its pale inside becomes soft when cooked in oil.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This colorful shape can appear in the sky after rain. Sunlight and drops of water help make it. It usually looks like a large curved band with several colors.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This falls from clouds when the air is cold enough. The tiny white pieces collect on the ground. Children can press them together to make balls or a round winter figure.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Drops of water fall from clouds during this weather. The ground becomes wet, and people open umbrellas outside. Plants receive water, but a long heavy period can cause floods.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Hard balls of ice fall from storm clouds. They measure at least five millimeters across, unlike smaller ice pellets. Large ones can break windows or damage cars and growing crops.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
During a storm, a bright flash may cross the sky. A loud rumbling or crashing sound follows it. This weather event happens because of electricity in the clouds and air.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Tiny drops of water float in the air near the ground. They make the view look white and hide things far away. Drivers must be careful when this becomes thick.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Small water drops shine on grass early in the day. No rain needs to fall for them to appear. They form during a cool night and are often gone after the morning warms up.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A thin white layer can cover grass on a freezing morning. It is made of tiny ice crystals. Water in the air forms this coating directly on a very cold surface.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This floats high in the sky and can hide the sun. It is made of tiny water drops or ice crystals. Some look white and soft, while others look dark.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You cannot usually see this, but you can feel it on your face. It moves leaves and can carry a kite upward. It is simply air moving from place to place.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This powerful tropical storm often reaches Japan from the south. Strong winds turn around its center, and heavy rain can follow. A calmer area sometimes forms in the middle.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This very strong wind spins in a narrow column. It can reach from a storm cloud down to the ground. The moving funnel can lift objects and damage buildings.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This season brings many wet and cloudy days to much of Japan. It usually comes before the hottest summer weather. People carry umbrellas often and worry about clothes drying slowly.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A cold window can become wet on the inside of a warm room. Water from the air turns into little drops on it. The same thing happens outside a cold drinking glass.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This number describes how much water vapor is in the air. It is often shown as a percentage in weather reports. A high value can make a warm day feel sticky.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Air has weight and pushes on things around it. Weather maps show places where this push is stronger or weaker. A measuring tool called a barometer tells us its value.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This tells us how hot or cold the air is. Weather reports give a highest and lowest value for the day. People use a thermometer to measure it in degrees.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
The ground suddenly moves during this event. Buildings may shake, and things can fall from shelves. It happens when energy stored inside the Earth is suddenly released.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A large movement under the sea can cause these waves. They travel across the ocean and can rise near land. Powerful, fast water can then flood large areas along the coast.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This kind of mountain has an opening linked to hot material below the ground. Gas, ash, or melted rock can come out. Some remain quiet for a very long time.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This very hot material comes out of some mountains during an eruption. It is rock that has melted. It can flow across the ground before cooling and becoming solid again.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This is evidence of a living thing from long ago, preserved in rock. It may be a bone, shell, or even a footprint. Scientists study it to learn about ancient life.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Sand and mud can settle little by little over a long time. They form different bands under the ground. A cliff may show these bands stacked like the pages of a book.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This natural environment receives very little rain. Some parts are covered in sand, but others have rocks. Plants and animals living here must manage with very little water.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Snow builds up over many years and becomes a huge mass of ice. The heavy mass moves slowly over land. As it moves, it can change the shape of valleys.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This stone shape hangs down from the roof of a cave. Water drops leave tiny amounts of material behind. Over a very long time, those small deposits make it grow.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Water comes from under the ground at this place. People often enjoy bathing in it, especially when it is warm. Natural minerals in the water can give it a special smell or color.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You may seem to see water on a hot road, although the road is dry. Light bends while passing through air at different temperatures. This can create a misleading view of distant objects.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Colorful light sometimes moves across the night sky near the Earth's poles. It may look like a glowing curtain. Tiny particles from the sun interact with gases high above the ground.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
The sea level rises and falls regularly along a coast. A beach may become wider and then disappear again. The pull of the moon is an important cause of this change.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This bright object gives the Earth light and heat. It seems to cross the sky each day. It is actually a star, and our planet travels around it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This object travels around the Earth. We see it because it reflects light from the sun. Its shape in the sky seems to change from a thin curve to a circle.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this event, the daytime sky can become unusually dark. The moon moves between the Earth and the sun. It hides part or all of the sun from certain places.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This event can happen when the moon is full. The Earth stands between the sun and the moon. Our planet's shadow covers the moon, which may look dark red.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A quick line of light crosses the night sky. It appears when a small object from space heats up in the air. People sometimes make a wish before it disappears.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This object travels around the sun on a long path. It contains ice and dust. When it comes closer to the sun, a bright cloud and one or more tails may appear.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People connect stars in their imagination to make a picture. The picture may be an animal or a person. These named patterns help people describe different parts of the night sky.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
On a dark clear night, this looks like a pale band across the sky. Its light comes from many distant stars together. A Japanese summer story describes two lovers separated by it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large planet goes around the sun beyond Jupiter. It is mostly gas and has many moons. Its wide, bright rings make it especially easy to recognize in pictures.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This planet is next beyond Earth when moving away from the sun. Its surface has a reddish color. Machines from Earth have driven across it, looking at rocks and soil.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
When you drop a ball, it falls toward the ground. This force also keeps your feet on the Earth. It acts between objects with mass, including planets and stars.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This force resists motion when surfaces rub against each other. It helps shoes grip the ground instead of sliding. Rubbing your hands together can produce heat because of this effect.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Water pushes upward on an object placed inside it. This force helps a boat stay at the surface. It also makes a heavy object feel lighter when you lift it underwater.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This force can pull iron objects without touching them. It can also push two matching poles apart. A compass uses it to help show which direction is north.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
After walking on a carpet, you may feel a small shock when touching metal. Your hair may also stand up after rubbing it. These effects come from electric charge building up.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A small puddle can disappear even when nobody wipes it up. Water slowly changes from liquid into gas at its surface. Warmth and moving air often make this happen faster.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A pot of water gets hotter on a stove. Eventually, bubbles form throughout the liquid and rise quickly. At normal sea-level pressure, pure water reaches this stage at about one hundred degrees Celsius.
